intro: Work the stages in order. Nothing in this list is permanently missable: every story mission can be replayed from the pause menu and free roam continues after the finale. The flags below mark the trophies that are easiest to miss on a first run, so do them when the moment comes.

stages.text: Play the story straight through. Every chapter trophy and every mission trophy in this stage unlocks in order as you finish the missions — Gone Fishing, the four chapters, the final mission, and the named missions Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Do not worry about missing one: replay any mission from the pause menu.
stages.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale

stages.text: After the story opens up, follow the question-mark icons. Finish eight full stranger strands, including the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Stranger missions unlock as you explore, so sweep the map for new icons between story missions.
stages.title: Strangers — 8 strands and 5 finales

stages.text: The grind stage: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 race wins, fishing against Cal, one arcade game, meditation at all 18 spots, 50 challenges, a full bowling game at Kolt & Associates, and one of each of the 9 activity types. Pick the quick ones first and use the challenge menu to track progress.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, discover 100 vehicles, hunt Bret's unique animal, finish 3 card sets and WAiNK 100 spots. Then the crime set: bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, the jewelry store, and the situational trophies — Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the showroom smash, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the strange event. This stage holds most of the easy-to-miss flags, so read each guide before you attempt it.
stages.title: World and crime — explore, rob, and watch out

stages.text: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across the shops, buy all 8 garage properties, and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Money comes fastest from heists and vaults, so this stage pairs well with stage 4.
stages.title: Money and property

stages.text: Open the 100% checklist in the pause menu and mop up whatever is left — it is the final gold trophy. Earn it and the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, unlocks on its own.
stages.title: Cleanup — 100% and the platinum

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
